page.layout: One page of text, centred. At the top the printed page number. Below it three numbered groups of coin illustrations, each followed by a centred caption: V. (two coins, caption "Argent. apud Francif. Cardin. Barbarinum."), VI. (two coins, caption "Ex ære, apud Francif. Gualdum."), VII: (two coins, caption "Ex ære, apud Ludovicum Aubery."). At the foot the gathering signature. No margin text, no running head.
page.notes: Six coin illustrations (woodcuts) in three pairs, each pair under its number: V. two silver coins (a plant or branch on one side, a cup or chalice on the other); VI. two bronze coins (a chalice on one, a flowering plant on the other); VII. two bronze coins (a smoking chalice on one, a branching plant or tree on the other). The lettering around the coins is in Hebrew (Phoenician-style letters) inside the pictures; it is not running text and is not transcribed. The signature at the foot is read as "Ɛ 5" with the E doubtful.
